purpose: Establish that one real human can understand and exercise the bounded apparatus and produce condition-bound session evidence without an apparatus or legibility defect preventing the intended comparison.

participant.identity: pseudonymous session id generated by apparatus

c0Questions: Could the participant tell what action was available and commit a choice every round?
Could the participant distinguish when encounter information was visible versus concealed?
Could the participant understand the displayed build vector, challenge and score well enough to continue without external explanation?
Did all four run reflections and final JSON export complete without data loss?
Did any control, wording, pacing or presentation defect prevent the intended information-timing distinction from being exercised?
admissionRule: C0 passes only when the apparatus is mechanically and perceptually usable enough to exercise the declared information-timing manipulation and produce a complete export. Ratings or strategy text must not be interpreted as mechanism success at C0.
repairRule: Only apparatus, legibility, pacing, wording or export defects may be repaired under the same C0 protocol. Any change to the Player Value claim, information-timing manipulation, scoring, offer structure or core build rules requires a new protocol revision.
nextIfPass: Preserve the C0 package, keep Human mechanism standing UNASSESSED, and proceed to mechanism-appropriate multi-session Human evidence before directional narrowing.
nextIfFail: Record APPARATUS_DEFECT, repair only within the repair rule, and rerun C0.
